title: How Culturally Aware Are Vision-Language Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated image captions from vision-language models using a novel metric called the Cultural Awareness Score (CAS). The methodology involves assessing whether the model accurately identifies and describes culturally-specific information (like traditional dances, mythological creatures, and cultural symbols) and checking that the outputs adhere to Responsible AI principles by being free of toxic, hateful, discriminatory, or culturally offensive content.
